Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 23-Dec-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FIFTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - DEC 2025/JAN 2026  
  SUBJECT: HUM 3022/HUM_3022 ESSENTIALS OF MANAGEMENT  
  (SPL: COMPUTER SCIENCE & ENGINEERING/INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY)  
  ESSENTIALS OF MANAGEMENT [HUM 3022]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                      Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)               Explain the three levels of management. Examine the interrelationship between the three levels of       (4)  
  management and the varying importance of managerial skills at each level. Illustrate your answer  
  with suitable corporate examples for each level and skill.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
1B)               Analyze three cultural dimensions that can influence management practices and employee behavior (3)  
  in a multinational company operating across diverse countries. Give one example for each  
  dimension.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
1C)               Given the following corporate examples, apply your knowledge of types of plans to identify and          (3)  
  justify which type each scenario represents.  
  i) Zomato implements a hyper-local delivery plan focusing on tier-2 and tier-3 cities to increase its  
  customer base.  
  ii) Infosys enforces a work-from-home plan to ensure employee safety and operational continuity  
  during crises.  
  iii) HDFC Life follows a step-by-step claims approval plan to process customer insurance claims  
  efficiently.  
  iv) Flipkart restricts sellers from listing counterfeit products as per its strict compliance.  
  v) Reliance Foundation runs the "Digital Udaan" plan to provide rural youth with digital literacy  
  training.  
  vi) Asian Paints allocates an annual marketing budget to support nationwide promotional  
  campaigns and product launches.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2A)               Zomato a comprehensive online platform for food delivery, restaurant discovery, and dining              (4)  
  experiences across India and several international markets. Perform a SWOT analysis for Zomato  
  and create two TOWS strategies to capitalize on the opportunities.  
  i) Strong brand recognition and a large, loyal customer base across India.  
  ii) High operational costs and dependence on third-party delivery personnel.  
  iii) Expansion into tier-2 and tier-3 cities with growing digital penetration.  
  iv) Intense competition from Swiggy, Blinkit, and other hyper-local delivery startups.  
  v) Wide range of services including food delivery, dining-out, and subscription-based offerings.  
  vi) Limited profitability despite high revenue due to aggressive discount strategies.  
  vii) Diversification into grocery delivery, cloud kitchens, and international markets.  
  viii) Regulatory changes related to labor laws and food safety compliance.  
  Page #1

ix) Advanced technology platform for real-time tracking and efficient logistics management.  
  x) Vulnerability to service quality issues and customer complaints affecting brand image.  
  xi) Leveraging AI and data analytics to personalize customer experience and improve efficiency.  
  xii) Economic downturns reducing consumer spending on discretionary dining and deliveries.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
2B)   Explain the steps involved in organizing. Compare on four grounds between a startup and an             (3)  
  established multinational company in terms of formal and informal structure.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2C)   As the HR manager of a mid-sized manufacturing company, determine an appropriate span of            (3)  
  control for the production managers using the four factors. Explain how you would apply these  
  factors to decide the number of direct reports for each manager to ensure effective supervision and  
  minimize micromanagement.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3A)   Imagine you are the founder of a large automobile firm planning to introduce a Line and Staff      (3)  
  Organizational structure to improve technical decision-making and managerial control. Demonstrate  
  how the roles of line executives and staff specialists would operate in your firm to enhance  
  efficiency and specialization without creating conflicts of authority. Also draw an organizational  
  chart.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3B)   As the HR Manager of a mid-sized IT company, apply the benefits of integrating HRM and HRD             (3)  
  practices to design a strategy that improves employee productivity and retention.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
3C)   Nykaa, India's leading beauty and lifestyle retailer, has approached you to suggest them on how     (4)  
  they can use the Maslow's 'Hierarchy of Needs' to motivate employees at different career stages.  
  You need to make a report, explaining Nykaa how fulfilling each 'level-of-need' influences employee  
  engagement, performance, and retention within the organization.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4A)   How are employment tests instrumental in the selection procedure? With suitable representations,       (3)  
  list out the measures of human psychology and human characteristics.  
4B)   As the human resource manager of your technical organization which primarily consults investment (3)  
  and banking sectors, you hold the essential responsibility for the training and development of your  
  staff. Occasionally, it is necessary to send your staff members for both on-the-job and off-the-job  
  training. Therefore, list all the on-the-job and off-the-job training methods. Illustrate one on-the-job  
  training method and one off-the-job training method suitable for the current business context, using  
  relevant examples and/or representation.  
4C)   Analyse Authority leadership styles and evaluate their impact on employee motivation and               (4)  
  productivity.  
5A)   Company, a leading Indian infrastructure developer, is confronting a critical decline in employee      (3)  
  motivation and productivity. This trend, evidenced by rising attrition and widespread dissatisfaction,  
  has been traced to four core issues: poor working conditions, non-competitive compensation,  
  limited career growth, and a weak organizational culture. In response, management has initiated a  
  comprehensive review of its employee motivation policies to address these systemic concerns.  
  
  Identify the levels of Maslow's hierarchy of needs not being met at X Company.  
  Explain how the application of Maslow's theory can improve employee motivation and performance.  
  Critically evaluate the sufficiency of Maslow's theory in this context and consider the relevance of  
  other motivational models.  
  
  Page #2

5B)                   Analyse Authority leadership styles and evaluate their impact on employee motivation and               (3)  
  productivity.  
5C)                   Illustrate the eight steps of the controlling process using a block diagram and explain each step with (4)  
  a common example.  
  
  
  -----End-----
